title: Tags, Layers & Static Flags
description: Add meta‑data to GameObjects with tags, layers, and static flags for better organization and game logic.

slides.title: Tags 🏷️
slides.content:
# Identifying Objects by Name

**Tags** are strings you can assign to GameObjects to identify them in scripts. Common uses:
- Find an object by tag: `GameObject.FindWithTag("Player")`.
- Compare tags: `if (other.CompareTag("Enemy"))`.

Predefined tags: Untagged, Respawn, Finish, EditorOnly, MainCamera, Player, GameController.
You can add your own tags via **Edit → Project Settings → Tags and Layers**.

quizData.question: What is a typical use of tags?

options.text: To categorize and find GameObjects in scripts

quizData.explanation: Tags are used for identifying and filtering objects during gameplay logic.

slides.title: Layers 🎚️
slides.content:
# Rendering & Physics Grouping

**Layers** are bitmask‑based categories used mainly for:
- **Rendering**: Camera culling masks – a camera can render only certain layers.
- **Physics**: Collision matrix – you can make objects on certain layers ignore each other.
- **Raycasting**: You can cast rays only against specific layers.

The first 8 layers are built‑in (Default, TransparentFX, Ignore Raycast, Water, UI, etc.). You have 24 user layers (8–31) to customize.

quizData.question: How many user‑defined layers can you create?
quizData.explanation: Layers 0–7 are reserved; layers 8–31 (24 slots) are user‑definable.

slides.title: Static Flags ⚡
slides.content:
# Optimizing with Static Objects

In the top‑right of the Inspector, the **Static** checkbox tells Unity that the object won't move at runtime. This enables optimizations like:
- **Static Batching** – combines meshes to reduce draw calls.
- **Occlusion Culling** – hides objects not seen by the camera.
- **Lightmapping** – bakes lighting into textures.

You can also set the dropdown to specify which static systems to include (Navigation, Occluder, etc.).

quizData.question: Checking 'Static' on a GameObject helps Unity perform rendering optimizations.
quizData.explanation: Static objects can be batched together and have precomputed lighting, improving performance.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Organize with Layers

Always assign proper layers to your objects. For example, put all environment geometry on an "Environment" layer, and set your player's camera to only render Default and Environment layers. It separates concerns from the start.
